stories.title: Shubman Gill breaks silence on dropping good friend Siraj in Wellington Test

stories.title: Italian football match suspended after sent-off player returns to pitch with knife

stories.summary: Miley Cyrus has married her partner of four years Maxx Morando during a ceremony in Palm Springs, California. stories.title: How J&K recruitment Board’s cheating case put a spotlight on Lok Bhavan, CM office powers? | Explained

stories.title: Who is Baba Kalyani? Meet the industrialist facing a bitter family battle over ₹1 lakh crore wealth

stories.title: A solo traveller’s guide to San Francisco: 6 ways to experience the city on your own
stories.summary: Planning a solo trip to San Francisco? Explore scenic parks, iconic attractions, fascinating museums, local restaurants and lively nightlife across the city. The Californian city offers plenty for independent travellers, from scenic cycling routes and waterfront attractions to art museums, neighbourhood food spots, and live music venues.

stories.title: From kala pani to Rikers, history of island prisons and the waters used to lock people in | HT Explainers
stories.summary: In Alexandre Dumas's The Count of Monte Cristo, the young sailor Edmond Dantès works out where the gendarmes are rowing him only as the boat nears the Château d'If, a fortress on a rock off Marseille. stories.title: Everyday Explained: Why do wooden doors swell during monsoons and become difficult to shut?
stories.summary: From humidity to moisture absorption, an expert explains why wooden doors swell during monsoons and become difficult to shut. A door that closes effortlessly one day may suddenly start getting stuck in its frame when the rains arrive. This common monsoon inconvenience is not necessarily a sign of poor carpentry or damaged hinges.

stories.title: What happened to Jaylen Harrell? Police reveal alleged Uber driver assault before Titans star’s crash
stories.summary: Tennessee Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell is facing questions after a serious car accident in Tampa, Florida, left him hospitalized with major injuries. Police say the driver lost control after the reported incident, hitting another vehicle before crashing into a utility pole.

stories.title: Is air pollution putting India’s frontline workers at risk? | In Focus Podcast
stories.summary: With the onset of winter, air pollution levels in Indian cities have touched alarming highs once again. While discussions around air pollution often centre on soaring AQI levels, smog and measures to curb vehicular emissions, what tends to get overlooked is its disproportionate impact on the most vulnerable groups, particularly those whose jobs expose them to polluted air for prolonged periods.

stories.title: Can Congress Turn Anti-AAP Sentiment Into A Comeback in Punjab?
stories.summary: On November 4, Rahul Gandhi returned to Punjab, a State where the Congress party has historically known how to sway voters and win elections. Launching the campaign for the Punjab Assembly elections in Sangrur, an Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) stronghold, Rahul attacked the AAP’s record in government and argued that Punjab needed a government that worked for the State rather than being “run from Delhi”.

stories.title: Is your breathing at risk? A pulmonologist shares signs that your COPD might be in a flare-up
stories.summary: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a progressive lung condition that makes breathing difficult due to restricted airflow in the lungs. It includes conditions such as chronic bronchitis and emphysema. One of the major challenges for people living with COPD is the occurrence of flare-ups, also known as exacerbations.

stories.title: Who is taking part in France's recent street protests?
stories.summary: Student demonstrators demanding better conditions have been joined by yellow vest activists and others, angry about the rising cost of living. stories.title: Karthigai Deepam row explained: What is Deepathoon dispute, and why has Tamil Nadu challenged Supreme Court order?

stories.title: What do other planets smell like? The answer hides in their chemistry

stories.summary: Indian weddings have always been special and a close to heart celebration. stories.summary: On November 10, two days after Diwali, the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) cautioned people against trusting apps that "derive AQI from instantaneous hourly readings", because the national air quality index (AQI), it said, reflects "prolonged exposure, rather than a momentary reading". stories.summary: Looking for plans in Mumbai this weekend? stories.title: ‘Home-sick’: Mumbai exhibition explores Himalayan medicinal plants and disappearing habitats
stories.summary: By definition, homesickness refers to the unhappiness one experiences when away from home for an extended period. stories.summary: With several crore devotees expected to converge on Nashik and Trimbakeshwar during the 2027 Simhastha Kumbh Mela, the administration is turning to artificial intelligence (AI) and advanced surveillance technology to ensure effective crowd management and pilgrim safety.
